dexEn: Teabud has a tea leaf on its head. It smells fresh in spring.
dexZh: 茶芽宝头上长着一片茶叶，春天闻起来清清香香。

dexEn: Teabush grows new leaves every morning. Farmers pick them to make tea.
dexZh: 茶丛兽每天早上都长出新叶子，农民摘下来做茶。

dexEn: A small tea garden grows on its back. Birds rest in its leaves.
dexZh: 它背上长着一小片茶园，鸟儿在叶子里休息。

dexEn: Lampkit's tail glows like a little lamp. It lights the way home at night.
dexZh: 灯笼崽的尾巴像一盏小灯，晚上为人照亮回家的路。

dexEn: Lanternfox carries a red lantern at festivals. Children follow it in the street.
dexZh: 灯笼狐在节日里提着红灯笼，孩子们在街上跟着它走。

dexEn: Fireworkfox jumps into the sky and bursts into colors. Everyone cheers at New Year.
dexZh: 烟花狐跳上天空，炸开满天色彩。过新年时大家都为它欢呼。

dexEn: Puddleling loves rainy days. It jumps in every puddle on the road.
dexZh: 水洼仔最爱下雨天，路上每个水坑它都要跳一跳。

dexEn: Rainotter can call a small rain cloud. It waters the farms in summer.
dexZh: 雨水獭能叫来一小朵雨云，夏天帮农田浇水。

dexEn: When Stormotter is angry, the sky turns dark. Its tail shoots bright lightning.
dexZh: 风暴獭一生气，天空就变黑。它的尾巴能射出明亮的闪电。

dexEn: Crumbmouse eats bread crumbs in the park. It is small but very fast.
dexZh: 碎屑鼠在公园里吃面包屑。它个子小，跑得却很快。

dexEn: Picnicmouse carries a basket of food. It shares lunch with its friends.
dexZh: 野餐鼠提着一篮子食物，会和朋友们分享午餐。

dexEn: Breezelet rides the spring breeze. It sings when the wind is warm.
dexZh: 微风雀乘着春风飞。风暖和的时候它就唱歌。

dexEn: Kitewing flies high like a kite. Its long tail dances in the wind.
dexZh: 风筝翼像风筝一样高高飞起，长尾巴在风里跳舞。

dexEn: Silkling eats green leaves all day. It grows bigger every week.
dexZh: 丝丝虫整天吃绿叶子，每个星期都长大一点。

dexEn: Silkball sleeps inside a soft white ball. Please do not wake it up.
dexZh: 丝茧球睡在软软的白球里。请不要把它吵醒。

dexEn: Silkwing's wings shine like silk. People in old times made clothes from its thread.
dexZh: 丝翼蛾的翅膀像丝绸一样闪亮。古时候人们用它的丝做衣服。

dexEn: Berrybug looks like a red berry. It hides on farm bushes.
dexZh: 莓果虫看起来像一颗红莓果，喜欢躲在农场的灌木上。

dexEn: Berrybeetle guards the berry fields. It pushes away hungry birds with its horn.
dexZh: 莓果甲虫守护着莓果田，用角把饿肚子的鸟推开。

dexEn: Barnhoot lives on top of old barns. It hoots softly all night.
dexZh: 谷仓鸮住在老谷仓的屋顶上，整夜轻轻地咕咕叫。

dexEn: Woolpuff is soft like a cloud. Farm kids hug it on cold days.
dexZh: 羊毛球像云朵一样软，农场的孩子冷天会抱着它。

dexEn: Woolhorn has big round horns. Its warm wool makes nice winter hats.
dexZh: 卷角羊长着又大又圆的角，它的羊毛能织成暖和的冬帽。

dexEn: Pondlet swims under lotus leaves. It blows little bubbles for fun.
dexZh: 池塘仔在荷叶下游来游去，喜欢吹小泡泡玩。

dexEn: A pink lotus grows on Lotusfin's head. It opens in summer.
dexZh: 荷鳍鱼头上长着一朵粉色的荷花，夏天就会开放。

dexEn: Sunseed sits in the sun all day. Sunshine is its lunch.
dexZh: 阳光籽整天坐在太阳底下，阳光就是它的午饭。

dexEn: Sunbloom always turns its face to the sun. It feels sad on rainy days.
dexZh: 向阳朵总是把脸朝着太阳，下雨天就会不开心。

dexEn: Sunharvest brings a big harvest to farms. Its face is as bright as the sun.
dexZh: 丰收日葵给农场带来大丰收，它的脸像太阳一样明亮。

dexEn: Citycat knows every street in town. Ask it the way when you are lost.
dexZh: 街巷猫认得城里每一条街。迷路时可以问它怎么走。

dexEn: Bulbling glows when it is happy. It sleeps in lamps during the day.
dexZh: 灯泡仔开心时会发光，白天就睡在灯里。

dexEn: Lamppost stands by the road all night. It keeps city streets safe and bright.
dexZh: 路灯怪整晚站在路边，让城市的街道又安全又明亮。

dexEn: Punchbun is soft but strong. It trains in the kitchen every morning.
dexZh: 拳包子软软的，力气却很大。它每天早上都在厨房里练拳。

dexEn: Bunboxer wears red gloves. Its punch is as hot as fresh buns.
dexZh: 包子拳手戴着红手套，出拳像刚出锅的包子一样烫。

dexEn: Sourberry tastes very sour. Birds never eat it twice.
dexZh: 酸莓球的味道酸极了，鸟儿吃过一次就不敢再吃。

dexEn: Sourvine climbs up old walls. Its purple berries make you sneeze.
dexZh: 酸藤怪顺着老墙往上爬，它的紫莓果会让人打喷嚏。

dexEn: Fieldmole digs under farm fields. It helps the soil stay soft.
dexZh: 田野鼹在农田下面挖洞，让泥土保持松软。

dexEn: Its coat changes color with every season. A special stone helps it grow.
dexZh: 小季鹿的毛色随季节变化。一块特别的石头能帮它长大。

dexEn: Flowers open wherever Springdeer walks. It brings spring to cold forests.
dexZh: 春芽鹿走到哪里，哪里就开花。它把春天带进寒冷的森林。

dexEn: Summerdeer runs across hot fields. Its antlers are warm like summer sun.
dexZh: 夏阳鹿在炎热的田野上奔跑，它的鹿角像夏天的太阳一样暖。

dexEn: Autumndeer looks at the full moon in autumn. Its eyes can see the future.
dexZh: 秋月鹿在秋天看着满月，它的眼睛能看见未来。

dexEn: Snow falls quietly when Winterdeer walks by. It sleeps in snowy forests.
dexZh: 冬雪鹿经过时，雪花静静地飘落。它睡在积雪的森林里。

dexEn: Snowchick cannot fly yet. It slides on the ice on its belly.
dexZh: 雪绒雏还不会飞，它用肚子在冰上滑来滑去。

dexEn: Winterbeak dives into icy water for fish. It never feels cold.
dexZh: 冬喙鸟钻进冰冷的海水里抓鱼，它从来不觉得冷。

dexEn: Cakelet smells like sweet cake. It appears at birthday parties.
dexZh: 蛋糕宝闻起来像甜甜的蛋糕，常在生日派对上出现。

dexEn: Creamcake makes people smile. Its cream tastes different every day.
dexZh: 奶油糕能让人开心。它的奶油每天都是不同的味道。

dexEn: Cakecastle is as big as a house. Small cake monsters live inside it.
dexZh: 蛋糕城堡像房子一样大，小蛋糕怪兽们都住在里面。

dexEn: Towerbell rings every hour in the city. People set their clocks by it.
dexZh: 钟楼铃在城市里每小时响一次，人们按它的钟声对表。

dexEn: Pepperpop is very hot. Do not put it in your mouth!
dexZh: 辣椒爆辣得不得了，千万别放进嘴里！

dexEn: Paperkite was a kite lost in the wind. Now it flies alone at night.
dexZh: 纸鸢灵原本是一只被风吹走的风筝，现在它在夜里独自飞行。

dexEn: Crowlet loves shiny things. It takes keys and coins from windows.
dexZh: 小黑鸦喜欢亮晶晶的东西，会从窗边叼走钥匙和硬币。

dexEn: Nightcrow leads many crows across the city at night. Its eyes shine gold.
dexZh: 夜幕鸦夜里带着一群乌鸦飞过城市，它的眼睛闪着金光。

dexEn: Mooncake appears at the Mid-Autumn Festival. It watches the full moon with families.
dexZh: 月饼宝在中秋节出现，它和一家人一起赏月。

dexEn: Dewdrop rests on grass in the morning. It hides when the sun gets hot.
dexZh: 露珠仔早上停在草叶上，太阳变热时就躲起来。

dexEn: Dewfairy gives water to thirsty flowers. Its wings shine like rainbows.
dexZh: 露仙子给口渴的花儿喂水，它的翅膀像彩虹一样闪亮。

dexEn: Brickbit is a small brick with legs. It helps builders in the city.
dexZh: 砖块仔是一块长了腿的小砖头，在城里给建筑工人帮忙。

dexEn: Brickwall stands in front of towns. Strong winds cannot push it.
dexZh: 砖墙怪站在小镇前面，大风也推不动它。

dexEn: Brickgiant can build a bridge in one night. Travelers thank it every day.
dexZh: 砖石巨人一夜就能搭好一座桥，旅行的人每天都感谢它。

dexEn: Boltkite flies before a storm comes. Its feathers make little sparks.
dexZh: 电风筝总在暴风雨来之前飞起来，它的羽毛会冒出小火花。

dexEn: Thunderkite flies inside storm clouds. It is never afraid of thunder.
dexZh: 雷暴鸢在暴风云里飞，它从来不怕打雷。

dexEn: Snowbell rings softly when snow falls. Its song means winter is here.
dexZh: 下雪时雪铃花会轻轻地响，它的歌声告诉大家冬天来了。

dexEn: Milkcalf drinks lots of milk. It likes to play in green fields.
dexZh: 奶牛犊喝很多牛奶，喜欢在绿油油的田野里玩。

dexEn: Barnbull pulls heavy carts on the farm. It works hard all year.
dexZh: 谷仓牛在农场上拉很重的车，一年到头都很勤劳。

dexEn: Pollenpuff floats in the spring air. Bees like to follow it.
dexZh: 花粉团在春天的空气里飘，蜜蜂喜欢跟着它。

dexEn: Blossomkite drops pink petals from the sky. Every town it visits turns pink.
dexZh: 花瓣鸢从天上撒下粉色花瓣，它飞过的小镇都会变成粉色。

dexEn: Songbug sings in the fields on summer nights. Kids keep it as a pet.
dexZh: 夏天的夜里，鸣歌虫在田野里唱歌，孩子们会把它当宠物养。

dexEn: Jumprope jumps a thousand times a day. Its long tail works like a rope.
dexZh: 跳绳仔一天能跳一千下，它的长尾巴就像一根跳绳。

dexEn: Ropechamp wins every game at the sports festival. It never gets tired.
dexZh: 跳绳王在运动会上每场比赛都赢，它从来不会累。

dexEn: Bubblegum blows big pink bubbles. They stick to shoes and hair.
dexZh: 泡泡糖怪吹出大大的粉色泡泡，会粘在鞋子和头发上。

dexEn: Plumbat hangs in plum trees at night. It eats fruit that is too old.
dexZh: 紫李蝠夜里倒挂在李子树上，专吃放坏了的水果。

dexEn: Ribbonlet dances like a red ribbon. It appears near festival boats.
dexZh: 彩带龙宝像红丝带一样跳舞，常在节日龙舟附近出现。

dexEn: Ribbontail leads the dragon boat race. Drums play when it swims by.
dexZh: 彩带舞龙带领龙舟比赛，它游过时鼓声就响起来。

dexEn: Festivalwing flies over towns on holidays. Fireworks follow its long tail.
dexZh: 节庆飞龙在节日里飞过小镇，烟花跟着它的长尾巴绽放。

dexEn: Rockcandy looks sweet but it is very hard. Please do not bite it.
dexZh: 冰糖石看起来很甜，其实硬得很，千万别咬它。

dexEn: Foglet comes out on foggy mornings. It likes to play hide-and-seek.
dexZh: 雾灵灵在起雾的早上出来，最喜欢玩捉迷藏。

dexEn: Nightfog covers the whole town at night. Keep your lamp on.
dexZh: 夜雾灵晚上会把整个小镇盖住。记得把灯开着。

dexEn: Railsnake runs along train tracks. It takes travelers to faraway cities.
dexZh: 铁轨蛇沿着火车轨道飞奔，把旅客送到遥远的城市。

dexEn: Ferryshell carries people across the river on its back. It swims very slowly.
dexZh: 渡船龟用背驮着人们过河，它游得很慢很慢。

dexEn: Snowpaw leaves tiny prints in the snow. It loves snowball fights.
dexZh: 雪爪崽在雪地上留下小小的脚印，最爱打雪仗。

dexEn: Snowtiger walks quietly through winter forests. Its white coat keeps it hidden.
dexZh: 雪原虎在冬天的森林里静静地走，白色的皮毛让它很难被发现。

dexEn: Moonhop hops higher on full moon nights. It dreams of living on the moon.
dexZh: 月跳兔在满月的夜晚跳得更高，它梦想住到月亮上。

dexEn: Jaderabbit makes medicine under the moon. Its song helps people sleep well.
dexZh: 玉月兔在月光下做药，它的歌声能让人睡个好觉。

dexEn: Strawhat stands in rice fields all summer. It waves to keep birds away.
dexZh: 草帽人整个夏天都站在稻田里，挥手把鸟儿赶走。

dexEn: Hotpot is always warm and bubbly. Friends sit around it in winter.
dexZh: 火锅怪总是热乎乎、咕嘟咕嘟冒泡，冬天朋友们会围着它坐。

dexEn: Mudcake looks like a pie but it is made of mud. Do not eat it!
dexZh: 泥巴饼看起来像馅饼，其实是泥做的。可别吃它！

dexEn: Skyballoon carries travelers over mountains. Hot air keeps it up in the sky.
dexZh: 热气球怪载着旅客飞过群山，热空气让它一直飘在空中。

dexEn: Shadowpaw walks without a sound. It hides in the shadows of city walls.
dexZh: 影爪兽走路一点声音都没有，它躲在城墙的影子里。

dexEn: Maplefrog's leaf turns red in autumn. It sings by the pond after rain.
dexZh: 枫叶蛙头上的叶子秋天会变红，下过雨后它在池塘边唱歌。

dexEn: Rollbug rolls down the road like a ball. It loves long hills.
dexZh: 滚轮虫像球一样沿着马路滚下去，它最爱长长的坡。

dexEn: Wheelbug has wheels instead of feet. It races cars on big roads.
dexZh: 车轮虫没有脚，只有轮子，它会在大路上和汽车赛跑。

dexEn: Trainbeetle pulls ten carts behind it. Whole families travel on its back.
dexZh: 列车甲虫身后能拉十节车厢，一家人都可以坐在它背上旅行。

dexEn: Hailwing brings hail when it flies over farms. Farmers ring bells to warn everyone.
dexZh: 冰雹龙飞过农场时会下冰雹，农民会敲钟提醒大家。

dexEn: Thunderdrum beats the drum on its belly. The sound is as loud as thunder.
dexZh: 雷鼓兽敲打肚子上的鼓，声音像打雷一样响。

dexEn: Dancelion dances at the Spring Festival. It brings good luck for the new year.
dexZh: 舞狮兽在春节表演舞蹈，给新的一年带来好运。

dexEn: Stonecub eats small rocks in deep caves. It is very rare.
dexZh: 石幼崽在深深的山洞里吃小石头，非常少见。

dexEn: Duskrock wakes up at dusk. Its hard body can break big rocks.
dexZh: 暮岩兽在黄昏时醒来，它坚硬的身体能撞碎大石头。

dexEn: Duskdragon flies over mountains at dusk. Its wings cover the evening sky.
dexZh: 暮岩龙黄昏时飞过群山，它的翅膀能遮住傍晚的天空。
